how.text: Add your products once. Every night the pipeline does the rest, and the verdicts are waiting when you open the shop.

steps.title: AI finds the same product
steps.text: Keywords, category and pack size narrow thousands of listings to a few. Gemini confirms which ones really are your product.

steps.title: You get a verdict

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: These Terms & Conditions govern your access to and use of PriceAI. By creating an account or using the service, you agree to these terms.

sections.heading: 1. The service
body: PriceAI matches your product catalog against competitor prices scraped from publicly available price feeds published by Bulgarian retail chains, and suggests prices using automated matching and AI. Matches, price suggestions, statuses and reports are informational aids, not guarantees. Competitor data may be delayed, incomplete or inaccurate, and product matches made by the matching pipeline may occasionally be wrong.
You remain solely responsible for the prices you set and for verifying any suggestion before acting on it. PriceAI is not liable for pricing, margin or business decisions made using the service.

sections.heading: 2. Accounts
body: You must provide accurate information when creating an account and keep your login credentials confidential. You are responsible for all activity under your account. Tell us immediately if you suspect unauthorized access.

sections.heading: 3. Subscriptions and payment
body: Where PriceAI is offered on a paid plan, fees, billing cycle and any trial period are shown at signup or in your account settings. Fees are non-refundable except where required by law. We may change pricing with advance notice; continued use after a price change takes effect means you accept it.

sections.heading: 4. Acceptable use
body: You agree not to: misuse the service to scrape or resell competitor data obtained through PriceAI, attempt to circumvent rate limits or security controls, upload catalog data you do not have the right to use, or use the service in a way that disrupts it for other merchants.

sections.heading: 5. Your data
body: You retain ownership of the product catalog and pricing data you upload. You grant PriceAI a license to process that data solely to provide the service to you (matching, suggestions, reports and notifications).

sections.heading: 6. Disclaimers and limitation of liability
body: The service is provided "as is", without warranties of any kind, including accuracy or fitness for a particular purpose. To the maximum extent permitted by law, PriceAI is not liable for indirect, incidental or consequential damages, or for losses arising from pricing decisions, competitor data errors or service interruptions.

sections.heading: 7. Termination
body: You may stop using PriceAI and close your account at any time from account settings. We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms or applicable law.

sections.heading: 8. Changes to these terms
body: We may update these terms from time to time. Material changes will be announced in the app or by email before they take effect.

sections.heading: 9. Governing law
body: These terms are governed by the laws of Bulgaria. Disputes are subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the Bulgarian courts, without prejudice to any mandatory consumer-protection rights you may have.

sections.heading: 10. Contact
body: Questions about these terms: [legal company name], [UIC/EIK], [registered address] — team@priceai.bg.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data PriceAI collects, why, and the rights you have over it under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

sections.heading: 1. Who we are
body: PriceAI is operated by [legal company name], [UIC/EIK], [registered address] ("we", "us"), the data controller for the personal data described here. Contact: team@priceai.bg.

sections.heading: 2. Data we collect
body: Account data: email address, username and password (stored hashed by our authentication provider).
Catalog data: the products, prices and costs you add or import, which may include data about your business but is not personal data about you as an individual.
Usage data: language and theme preferences, and session cookies needed to keep you signed in.

sections.heading: 3. How we use it
body: To provide the service: authenticate you, store and match your catalog, run price comparisons, send in-app notifications and, if you ask, email account notices (password reset, confirmation).
We do not sell your data or use it for advertising.

sections.heading: 4. Legal basis
body: We process account and catalog data to perform our contract with you (providing the service), and usage cookies under our legitimate interest in keeping the service secure and working correctly.

sections.heading: 5. Who we share data with
body: Supabase, our database and authentication provider, which stores your account and catalog data.
Google Gemini, which receives only product names and attributes (never account or contact details) to confirm matches between your catalog and competitor listings.

sections.heading: 6. Cookies
body: We use functional cookies only: a session cookie to keep you signed in, and cookies that remember your language and theme choice. We do not use third-party advertising or analytics cookies.

sections.heading: 7. Data retention
body: Account and catalog data is kept while your account is active. Competitor price history is kept to power trend reports. In-app notifications are kept for a limited number of days and then removed automatically. You can request deletion of your account and associated data at any time.

sections.heading: 8. Your rights
body: Under GDPR you have the right to access, correct, delete or export your personal data, and to object to or restrict certain processing. To exercise these rights, contact team@priceai.bg. You may also lodge a complaint with Bulgaria's Commission for Personal Data Protection (CPDP).

sections.heading: 9. Security
body: We use industry-standard measures (encryption in transit, access controls, hashed passwords) to protect your data. No method of transmission or storage is fully secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

sections.heading: 10. Changes to this policy
body: We may update this policy from time to time. Material changes will be announced in the app or by email before they take effect.

import.title: Import a price list
import.help: A CSV file with a header row: name and price are required, brand, size, sku and cost are optional. Comma or semicolon separators and decimal commas both work, so you can save straight from Excel. Products are matched by SKU, or by name, brand and size.

suggest.title: Possible matches
suggest.help: We couldn’t confirm these listings are your product, often because the name leaves out a detail such as fat % or pack size. Use the ones that are the same product and their prices count towards your status. Adding the missing detail to the name also lets matching find it on its own.
